analysis.title: Americas Clean Technology: Solar. RE+ 2026 takeaways: Demand resilient across utility-scale and storage, while resi macro remains most uncertain
key_insights: GS keeps its constructive view on utility-scale solar and storage after RE+ meetings. Demand is described as resilient with decent visibility into the next few years, and growth is shifting toward share gains, wallet expansion and new end markets such as data centers.

Field work suggests utility-scale volumes stay elevated through at least 2029, with slower y/y growth. NXT, ARRY/SHLS and GameChange are focused on wallet share through broader product attach across trackers, foundations, eBOS and power conversion.

Industry participants think an expansion of the 45X PTC and 48E ITC could be in play given Democratic Congressional control. Views on the 25D ITC were more subdued. Growing optimism on permitting is seen as a possible wild card for large-scale solar and storage volumes.

The 2027 US residential outlook is subdued, with interest rates and financing the main constraints. GS sees downside risk to a 2027 growth recovery, with improving 2H trends and stronger economics in higher-rate markets as partial offsets.

Ohm Analytics now expects flat US residential installations in 2027, down from an earlier view of a return to growth. RUN still guides to mid-to-high-single-digit company growth while acknowledging FEOC, interest rate and California property tax uncertainty in early 2027.
Higher-rate Northeast and PJM markets continue to outperform because wider utility bill savings improve third-party-owned (TPO) customer economics.

Residential storage is the bright spot. Texas residential storage tripled last year, about 80% was standalone, and average systems are about 45kWh versus about 18kWh nationally. GS says storage is becoming a growth driver independent of solar volumes.

RUN generates about $40mn of VPP revenue and over $10mn of gross profit with only about half of eligible batteries participating. Management sees scope to roughly double participation and expects hyperscaler awards over the next few quarters, with Virginia and New Jersey as initial markets.

Data center power drew universal focus at the conference, but 2027 is still primarily a validation year. ENPH, SEDG and SHLS are each pursuing different data center power architectures, and GS says early customer wins and technical validation matter more than near-term revenue.

ENPH targets about 150-250MW of revenue-generating SST pilots in 2027 at about 30-40¢/W, with commercial orders in 2027 for 2028 delivery. It cites about 98% power conversion efficiency versus about 92%-93% for conventional multi-stage designs.

ENPH says interest rates are the largest swing factor for 2027 residential demand. Section 232 has had no meaningful impact on residential demand or pricing so far, with residential module pricing at about 36-37¢/W. GS sees rate relief as the cleaner upside lever.

RUN says every 25bps of higher interest rates is about a $30mn annual cash-generation headwind, and California property tax would need about 5% higher pricing to offset. GS says execution on direct sales growth and pricing becomes more important given limited appetite to reinstate 25D.

RUN is reducing exposure to affiliate partners that fall short on customer quality, domestic content and FEOC requirements, which weighs on volumes. Management calls competing TPO pricing aggressive and in some cases unsustainable.

ARRY and SHLS have a pending merger. Management pitches a scaled platform across trackers, foundations and eBOS as a competitor to NXT, with about 20% customer overlap as cross-sell potential. GS is acting as financial advisor on the deal, so ARRY and SHLS are Not Rated.

About 60% of ARRY's order book is tied to recently launched products and about 50% comes from non-EPC customers. Steel prices are up about 50%, but more than 50% of contracted deliveries are fixed price and steel can be locked back to back for deliveries within about 12 months. Longer-dated projects stay more exposed.

SEDG expects a 4Q26 inventory reset that extends into 1Q27, with another sequential decline before recovery through 2027. It targets mid-20% gross margins for 2027, helped by a full year of Nexis, higher 45X utilization and cost reductions. Management is more constructive on Germany after signs that EEG support could stay for systems up to 25kW.

SEDG expects a working SST product by year end, with 34.5kV the key remaining milestone and several pilots in 2027. It is in talks with hyperscalers, neoclouds and NVIDIA on the 800VDC ecosystem, but calls 2028-29 the scale-up period. GS treats SST as optionality, not a near-term earnings driver.

NXT raised its FY2030 revenue and adjusted EBITDA targets to above $7.5bn and above $1.6bn, driven by higher product attach and the addition of storage. FY2028 margins are expected to step down to the high teens as newer businesses scale. GS remains constructive.

GameChange (private) expects 8-10GW of US deployments in 2026 versus 5.5GW in 2025, with US share in the high-20% range. It sees the underlying US market flat to modestly higher, so share gains drive volume. It targets about 10% eBOS share rising toward 20%, and is raising tracker pricing for the first time in about 2 years because steel is 65%-70% of tracker cost.

SHLS cites gross margin above 34% excluding warranty costs versus reported 3Q26 of 31.9%, with line of sight to the mid-30% range. Air Link initial commercial sales are expected in 2027 and the product is a ~10-12¢/W opportunity. GS says early Air Link wins matter more strategically than near-term revenue.

GS ratings in the report: Buy on FSLR ($272), NXT ($127), RUN ($13) and ENPH ($40). Neutral on FLNC ($7) and HASI ($43). Sell on SEDG ($25), CSIQ ($10), JKS ($7) and NRGV ($3.25). ARRY and SHLS are Not Rated.

market_movers.rationale: 12-month target based on a 10x ex-cash P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS with $20 per share of net cash added back. Risks are module oversupply, higher module costs, trade policy and changes to US manufacturing credits.
12-month target based on a 20x P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS. NXT raised its FY2030 revenue and adjusted EBITDA targets, and GS likes the diversified growth from higher product attach and storage.

NAV-based target. RUN guides to mid-to-high-single-digit 2027 growth, and VPP monetization lifts revenue and gross profit off the existing battery base. Rates and California property tax are the main risks.
Target uses an 18x P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS plus $8 of net cash per share. SST pilots of about 150-250MW are targeted for 2027, and rate relief is the main upside lever for residential.
Target is 50% DCF and 50% EV/Sales at 0.4x FY2027E revenue. Risks include Houston ramp delays and the pace of storage adoption and revenue recognition.
Target based on P/B and dividend yield. Risks include the pace of MW growth, net metering policy and interest rates.
Target based on a 17x P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS. The 4Q26 inventory reset extends into 1Q27, and GS sees SST as optionality rather than a near-term earnings driver.
Target based on EV/EBITDA and SOTP. Risks to the Sell include faster module ASP recovery and faster storage adoption.
Target based on EV/EBITDA. Risks include faster cost declines, lower poly pricing and removal of global solar trade restrictions.
Target based on EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA. Risks include higher market demand and faster cost declines.

sector_views.rationale: Constructive view intact. Demand is stable with visibility, and growth increasingly comes from share gains, product attach and new end markets.
2027 outlook is subdued with downside risk. Interest rates and financing are the main constraints, with FEOC clarity and rate relief the potential catalysts.
Standalone deployments, larger systems and VPP monetization make storage a growth driver independent of solar volumes.
Commercial activity is moving closer, but 2027 is primarily a validation year and scale is expected in 2028-29.

earnings_insights: SHLS reported 3Q26 gross margin of 31.9%. Management cites above 34% excluding warranty costs and a line of sight to the mid-30% range as warranty headwinds normalize.

SEDG guides a 4Q26 reset that includes about $35mn of channel inventory management tied to FEOC and German policy uncertainty, about $5mn of FX headwinds and about $10mn from de-emphasizing Australia and another market. Management expects another sequential decline in 1Q27 (guidance, not reported).
SEDG management targets mid-20% gross margins for 2027 (guidance) and expects residential revenue to grow for the full year 2027.
RUN management expects mid-to-high-single-digit overall growth in 2027 (guidance), supported by recent high-single to low-double-digit direct sales growth.
NXT Capital Markets Day: FY2030 targets raised to above $7.5bn revenue and above $1.6bn adjusted EBITDA (company targets), with FY2028 margins expected to step down to the high teens.
GameChange (private) expects 8-10GW of US deployments in 2026 versus 5.5GW in 2025 (company expectation).
ARRY steel inflation of about 50% creates near-term margin pressure from the lag between contracting and procurement. More than 50% of contracted deliveries are fixed price.
Ohm Analytics (private) expects flat US residential installations in 2027 and low-to-mid-single-digit C&I growth (third-party forecast).

macro_indicators.reading: Every 25bps higher is about a $30mn annual cash-generation headwind for RUN
macro_indicators.interpretation: Rates are the key swing factor for 2027 residential demand. Rate relief is the cleaner upside lever per GS and ENPH.
Pressures tracker margins near term through the lag between contracting and procurement. More than 50% fixed-price coverage limits ARRY's margin downside.

risk_factors: Higher interest rates and tight financing for residential solar, with downside risk to a 2027 recovery.
FEOC guidance timing and content, which could delay or change residential and affiliate volumes.
California property tax adding about $10k-$15k of incremental assessed value per residential system, a further residential headwind.
Steel inflation of about 50% pressuring tracker margins, especially on longer-dated projects.
Limited political appetite to reinstate the 25D ITC for residential.
Aggressive and possibly unsustainable TPO competitor pricing.
Data center power products (SST, Air Link) are unproven, with 2027 a validation year and meaningful contribution not expected until 2028-29.
SEDG inventory reset and sequential revenue decline into 1Q27, and German policy not yet final.
Module oversupply, trade policy and changes to US manufacturing credits (FSLR risks).
geopolitical: Section 232 tariffs have not had a meaningful impact on residential demand or pricing to date, per ENPH management.
FEOC (foreign entity of concern) rules and guidance are a key 2027 swing factor for residential solar. Ohm's base case assumes guidance in 1Q.

tension_points.bull_case: RUN expects mid-to-high-single-digit company growth in 2027, supported by recent high-single to low-double-digit direct sales growth. Higher-rate Northeast/PJM markets are outperforming, and Ohm's base case has growth improving to mid-single-digit y/y by 3Q/4Q with FEOC guidance in 1Q.
tension_points.bear_case: Ohm now expects flat US residential installations in 2027 after previously seeing growth. Interest rates and financing are the primary constraint, 25D is unlikely to be reinstated, and California property tax adds a headwind. GS sees downside risk to a 2027 recovery.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Ohm's base case depends on FEOC guidance arriving in 1Q. A later FEOC guidance date, or no interest rate relief, would undermine the second-half recovery.

tension_points.theme: SST data center power revenue timing
tension_points.bull_case: ENPH targets about 150-250MW of revenue-generating SST pilots in 2027 and has customer discussions with a global AI company and a hyperscaler. SEDG is in talks with hyperscalers, neoclouds and NVIDIA on 800VDC, and SHLS expects initial Air Link commercial sales in 2027.
tension_points.bear_case: SEDG management reiterates 2028-29 as the scale-up period, limiting near-term financial contribution. GS calls 2027 a validation year and sees SST as optionality rather than a near-term earnings driver.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The 34.5kV medium-voltage demonstration and the 2027 pilots are the proof points. Failure to reach the 34.5kV milestone or to land pilots in 2027 would undercut the thesis.
